releases.name: The last keeper
releases.summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

releases.name: Tai Chi Tarot
releases.summary: In the game world You control a super metal ball As needed Looking for super property licensing Changed to Four kinds of attributes form Break down barriers The triumph Very simple Come and try.

releases.name: EEL KNOW:Perfect Pitch
releases.summary: A garden eel's length is your clue to the pitch! Guess sounds on the keyboard to train your absolute pitch. Correct answers add eels with unique sounds to your encyclopedia. Create custom quizzes, unlock new instrument tones, and send them to friends to sharpen your ears together!

releases.name: Crystalase
releases.summary:
Turn crystals into masterpieces.

Crystalase is a relaxing puzzle game. Players assemble beautiful images made entirely of sparkling crystals. Each level involves placing crystal pieces in the correct positions to gradually reveal intricate, colourful artwork.
Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.
Crystalase is perfect for puzzle lovers and anyone who enjoys creativity, focus and a touch of sparkle.

releases.name: Stelvyr: Colony Defense
releases.summary: Build and defend a space colony where every unit of power and every crew assignment matters. Expand production, research new technologies, shape the battlefield with walls and weapons, and adapt your strategy against alien swarms across nine campaign operations.

releases.name: HELIX ARK
releases.summary: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

releases.name: The Little Cloud
releases.summary: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

releases.name: Sala Manager
releases.summary: Master the hardcourt in Sala Manager, a high-speed futsal simulation where football meets lightning-fast chess. Solve intense tactical puzzles, execute 5v5 real-time rotations, and build an indoor tycoon empire. Small court. Relentless pace.

releases.name: Glims
releases.summary: Welcome to Piano Touch. Tap to play, chose from two different piano's. Play background music while you play your piano. Isn't it great now you have your own piano all on your iPhone/iPod/iPad.

releases.name: Swarmbreaker
releases.summary: The struggle to protect the ancient ninja scroll of Knowledge and Power has always been a task for the strongest and pure of heart, and one such ninja exists, Katsuo the Stick Ninja. For many years Stick Ninja has been the protector and keeper of the ancient scroll. He has learned its ways and vowed to use its power to help the needy and defend the weak. What Stick Ninja does not know is that an evil force is being conjured to find the scroll and take it from its keeper. The struggle to protect the scroll may cost Stick Ninja more than he knows. With his Dragon Princess kidnapped, and the scroll’s location compromised, he must find Akemi, the Dragon Princess, and still protect the scroll from Evil. The Stick Ninja quest begins…Save the Dragon Princess and the Ancient Scroll of Knowledge and Power from the evil leader of the Crane Warriors, Kasuki.

releases.name: Piggy Monte
releases.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

releases.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
releases.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

releases.name: Starlight Cove
releases.summary: Make some lemonade and set sail in this cozy fishing incremental game. Catch weird fish across colorful locations, upgrade your gear, rebuild Starlight Cove back to its former glory, and defeat the evil shark that stole your grandfather's greatest treasure years ago.

releases.name: Expiration
releases.summary: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.

releases.name: Kamiyo
releases.summary: A dystopian visual novel about Gods, humans and the 'Godkillers'. Pray to your God, and death to the Godkillers.

releases.name: About Frontlines
releases.summary: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

releases.name: Warpack
releases.summary: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills — forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

releases.name: Grindveil
releases.summary: A free idle MMORPG that keeps playing while you do not. Pick a class, send your hero into the Rifts, and come back to full pockets. Then spend it on arena duels, guild wars, and a server wide faction war that shifts the world every week.

releases.name: Nova Protocol
releases.summary: Drift, drag, slide ! 'Turbo Skiddy Racing' makes racing even tougher than ever.You race against up to 7 cars and truck. As an experienced racer, you will have to manage driving your car on bumpers and jumps, narrow roads and even ice (on night and day tracks). Don't let you get overtaken by the fast computer driven cars, avoid collisions and win the championships!The game is built on the best vehicle physics engine available for real driving sensations and a very effective computer driven cars artificial intelligence system. It features high definition 3D graphics, along with rock musics and realistic sound fx.If you like car games, this one is different, this one is for you!3 championships included.

releases.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
releases.summary: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

releases.name: The Sea is Our Stage
releases.summary: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

releases.name: A Quiet Place Between Us
releases.summary:
A beautiful romance visual novel where love blossoms gently before drifting toward heartbreak. 

Guide Hina and Kenta through a warm yet fragile relationship shaped by outside pressure, hidden motives, and painful choices leading to emotional multiple endings.

releases.name: Hexograph
releases.summary: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

releases.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
releases.summary: An addictive idle brick-breaker meets Bullet Heaven. Descend a dark abyss, buy heaps of bouncy orbs, and watch them smash hordes of skeletons to dust. No manual aiming, no reloading—just absolute physics chaos and satisfying chain reactions!

releases.name: Gobs & Gears
releases.summary: Reconstruct a Gob factory lost in the Fog. Route resources, put the Gobs to work, and build the BIG BOOM. The Gob King wants his bomb and he wants it NOW!
